summary: Candidate is a specialized variant of AgentOps session initialization that combines auto-start session setup with trace creation and OpenAI client instantiation. It should merge into the existing broader session initialization skills (741b0179 and aa70b4ce) which already cover the core init patterns. The candidate adds OpenAI client instantiation and explicit trace_name/tags parameters, but these are minor additive details that belong in a unified, more comprehensive session initialization skill rather than as a separate capability.
